e.title: Indian Health Insurance Claim Help
e.summary: 印度健康险理赔审核 AI skill（53★，MIT，SKILL.md）：保单/期限/凭证核对+缺件定位+PDF 组装
e.body: Indian Health Insurance Claim Help（DhananjayBhosale，53★，MIT，Python 3.11+，2026-08 活跃）是基于 SKILL.md 的 AI skill：审计并组装印度健康险住院/院前/院后理赔 PDF（不改动原始证据）——核对保险公司/产品/UIN/TPA/保单窗口/截止日与提交渠道，把每张处方/医嘱/报告/明细账单/付款收据匹配到对应费用，指出缺失证据（精确到来源文件与页码）、重复费用/总额不一致/未支持行/缺页/门户限额问题，构建审查版与上传版 PDF（保留源文件与哈希）。适用于任何能读本地文件并遵循 SKILL.md 的 AI 助手（Claude Code/Codex 等）。对 RIAA：保险理赔审核的 concrete skill 范例——与 [[ifrs-skill]]（IFRS 引用 skill）、[[actuarial-skills]]（P&C 精算 skills）同类；理赔文档处理对接 [[claims-processing-hack]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]；注意 skill 只做准备不决定资格，最终由保单/保险公司决定。

e.summary_en: Indian health-insurance claims-audit AI skill (53★, MIT, SKILL.md): policy/deadline/evidence checking + missing-item location + PDF assembly
e.summary_hk: 印度健康險理賠審核 AI skill（53★，MIT，SKILL.md）：保單/期限/憑證核對+缺件定位+PDF 組裝
e.body_en: Indian Health Insurance Claim Help (DhananjayBhosale, 53★, MIT, Python 3.11+, active 2026-08) is a SKILL.md-based AI skill that audits and assembles Indian health-insurance claim PDFs (hospitalisation, pre-/post-hospitalisation) without changing the original evidence: it checks the exact insurer / product / UIN / TPA / policy window / deadline / submission route, matches every prescription/advice/report/itemised bill/payment receipt to an expense, names the missing evidence (down to source file and page), finds duplicate expenses / total mismatches / unsupported lines / missing pages / portal-limit issues, and builds separate review and upload-ready PDF candidates while preserving source files and hashes. Works with any AI assistant that reads local files and follows SKILL.md (Claude Code/Codex etc.). For RIAA: a concrete insurance-claims-audit skill example — the same family as [[ifrs-skill]] (IFRS citation skill) and [[actuarial-skills]] (P&C actuarial skills); claims-document handling connects to [[claims-processing-hack]] and [[claims-intake-agent]]; note the skill prepares, it does not decide eligibility — the policy and insurer assessment remain decisive.
e.body_hk: Indian Health Insurance Claim Help（DhananjayBhosale，53★，MIT，Python 3.11+，2026-08 活躍）是基於 SKILL.md 的 AI skill：審計並組裝印度健康險住院/院前/院後理賠 PDF（不改動原始證據）——核對保險公司/產品/UIN/TPA/保單窗口/截止日與提交渠道，把每張處方/醫囑/報告/明細賬單/付款收據匹配到對應費用，指出缺失證據（精確到來源文件與頁碼）、重複費用/總額不一致/未支持行/缺頁/門戶限額問題，構建審查版與上傳版 PDF（保留源文件與哈希）。適用於任何能讀本地文件並遵循 SKILL.md 的 AI 助手（Claude Code/Codex 等）。對 RIAA：保險理賠審核的 concrete skill 範例——與 [[ifrs-skill]]（IFRS 引用 skill）、[[actuarial-skills]]（P&C 精算 skills）同類；理賠文檔處理對接 [[claims-processing-hack]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]；注意 skill 只做準備不決定資格，最終由保單/保險公司決定。
